SELECT u.uid, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.descript, u.sex, u.is_vip, f.create_time AS follow_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS follow_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.follow_user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS fans_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.like_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_like_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.play_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_play_count FROM public.user_follow f INNER JOIN public.user_info u ON u.id = f.follow_user_id AND u.is_delete = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_delete = 0
AND (u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT u.uid, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.descript, u.sex, u.is_vip, f.create_time AS follow_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS follow_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f1 WHERE f1.follow_user_id = u.id AND f1.is_delete = 0) AS fans_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.like_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_like_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.play_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS total_play_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_follow f2 WHERE f2.user_id = #{userId} AND f2.follow_user_id = u.id AND f2.is_delete = 0) AS followed_back FROM public.user_follow f INNER JOIN public.user_info u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.is_delete = 0 WHERE f.follow_user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_delete = 0
AND (u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
